Definition: to dash asunder; by implication, to crush, smash or violently plunge; figuratively, to subdue or destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to smite through, shatter, wound severely; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to shatter; 1a2) shattering (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
